root.label: ProPublica reports Trump officials listed multiple primary residences on mortgages

events.label: ProPublica reports Trump officials listed multiple primary residences on mortgages

slots.name: official count
slots.sentence: Former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Environmental Protection Agency Administrator Lee Zeldin have all called more than one property their “primary residence” on mortgage applications, according to a report last year from ProPublica.
